title: REQ-20261103-OPS001 — Adviser fee consent: ongoing advice fee $3,300 p.a. incl. GST (Priya Natarajan / Hannah Lewis, SIS s99FA)
content:
Caldova Adviser Fee Consent (ongoing fee arrangement) signed by Priya Natarajan on 30 Oct 2026 and lodged with the application pack.

Consent details: account holder Priya Natarajan; account Caldova Super (Select), member number CS-2049817. Adviser: Hannah Lewis CFP®, adviser code ADV-10442, Yarra Private Wealth (Collins St, Melbourne). Fee type: ongoing advice fee. Amount: $3,300 a year including GST ($3,000 plus $300 GST), deducted in 12 monthly instalments of $275 from the Caldova Super account and paid to Yarra Private Wealth. Services: annual review of her super strategy and investments; ongoing monitoring of the Growth model against her risk profile; contributions and insurance-in-super reviews; access to her adviser by phone and email. Fee period: 12 months from 30 Oct 2026. Statement included: Priya can end the arrangement and withdraw her consent at any time by telling Caldova or her adviser in writing; deductions stop once Caldova receives the notice. Signed and dated by the member.

Assessment (Benefits & Eligibility; SIS Act s99FA and Corporations Act Pt 7.7A Div 3): fee is for personal advice about her interest in Caldova Super ✅; written consent signed and dated by the member ✅; account name and number stated ✅; dollar amount and frequency stated ✅; services stated ✅; 12-month fee period ✅; withdrawal statement ✅; Caldova holds a copy ✅. Result: consent VALID — the fee can be set up once the account is open.

Renewal: the arrangement must be renewed in writing every year. No separate reference day was agreed, so the first renewal window is based on the anniversary of the arrangement (30 Oct 2027): it opens 31 Aug 2027 (60 days before) and closes 28 Mar 2028 (150 days after). If Priya has not renewed by the end of 28 Mar 2028, her consent ceases, the arrangement terminates and Caldova stops the fee.

Fees in dollars (for Investment Solutions and Client Communications): adviser fee $3,300 plus Caldova costs of about $1,175.04 on $138,200 in Growth = about $4,475.04 a year in total.
